paragraphs.source_en: Soon after Tokugawa Ieyasu entered the castle, he erected an imposing keep in the western gardens of Osaka Castle. Though it could not compare with the main castle keep, it was still rather lavish for the residence of the young lord's regent.

units.source_en: Soon after Tokugawa Ieyasu entered the castle, he erected an imposing keep in the western gardens of Osaka Castle.
units.source_zh: 德川家康进城不久，就在大坂城西苑筑起一座庄严的天守阁。

units.source_en: Though it could not compare with the main castle keep, it was still rather lavish for the residence of the young lord's regent.
units.source_zh: 虽与本城天守阁无法相比，但作为少君摄政大臣的府邸，还是略有些豪华了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 德川家康进城不久，就在大坂城西苑筑起一座庄严的天守阁。虽与本城天守阁无法相比，但作为少君摄政大臣的府邸，还是略有些豪华了。

paragraphs.source_en: Just as rumors were swirling, the Maeda agreed to surrender a hostage, leaving the world dumbfounded once again.

units.source_en: Just as rumors were swirling, the Maeda agreed to surrender a hostage, leaving the world dumbfounded once again.
units.source_zh: 就在流言四起时，前田却答应交出人质，世人又一次目瞪口呆。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在流言四起时，前田却答应交出人质，世人又一次目瞪口呆。

paragraphs.source_en: Hōshun-in explained, “There is precedent for this as well. Lord Asano has already sent his son to Edo. After the Battle of Komaki and Nagakute, Ōmandokoro also went to Okazaki as a hostage. So long as it is for peace throughout the realm, I would gladly pass through fire and water.”

units.source_en: Hōshun-in explained, “There is precedent for this as well.
units.source_zh: 芳春院的解释是：“此事亦有先例。

units.source_zh: 浅野大人已把儿子交到江户。

ja.t: のためであるなら、たとえ

units.source_zh: 只要是为了天下太平，我宁愿赴汤蹈火。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 芳春院的解释是：“此事亦有先例。浅野大人已把儿子交到江户。小牧长久手之战以后，大政所也到冈崎为质。只要是为了天下太平，我宁愿赴汤蹈火。”

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, behind Hōshun-in's noble understanding lay Kōdai-in's tremendous efforts. Kōdai-in devoted herself to carrying on Hideyoshi's dying wish, taking it as her mission to “preserve peace throughout the realm forever.” Fortunately, however, the affair did not stir up a violent storm.

units.source_en: In truth, behind Hōshun-in's noble understanding lay Kōdai-in's tremendous efforts.
units.source_zh: 其实，芳春院的深明大义背后，有着高台院的巨大努力。

units.source_en: Kōdai-in devoted herself to carrying on Hideyoshi's dying wish, taking it as her mission to “preserve peace throughout the realm forever.”
units.source_zh: 高台院一心继承秀吉遗志，以“永保天下太平”为己任。

units.source_en: Fortunately, however, the affair did not stir up a violent storm.
units.source_zh: 但幸运的是，此事并未激起惊涛骇浪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，芳春院的深明大义背后，有着高台院的巨大努力。高台院一心继承秀吉遗志，以“永保天下太平”为己任。但幸运的是，此事并未激起惊涛骇浪。

paragraphs.source_en: Next came the Mōri and the Uesugi. Once the Mōri and Uesugi became Ieyasu's allies, Mitsunari would have no choice but to obey. Ieyasu understood all this perfectly well. But ever since Mōri Terumoto returned to his domain the previous year, he had ignored both Ieyasu and Mitsunari, instead corresponding frequently with Uesugi Kagekatsu in Aizu—sometimes asking about conditions in Ōu, sometimes informing the Uesugi of developments at court…

units.source_en: Next came the Mōri and the Uesugi.
units.source_zh: 接下来便是毛利氏与上杉氏。

units.source_en: Once the Mōri and Uesugi became Ieyasu's allies, Mitsunari would have no choice but to obey.

units.source_en: Ieyasu understood all this perfectly well.
units.source_zh: 对这些，家康心知肚明。

units.source_en: But ever since Mōri Terumoto returned to his domain the previous year, he had ignored both Ieyasu and Mitsunari, instead corresponding frequently with Uesugi Kagekatsu in Aizu—sometimes asking about conditions in Ōu, sometimes informing the Uesugi of developments at court…
units.source_zh: 但毛利辉元自从去年返回领国之后，就对家康和三成置之不顾，而是与会津的上杉景胜频频联系，或询问奥羽情形，或向上杉通报朝廷动态……

paragraphs.source_zh: 接下来便是毛利氏与上杉氏。一旦毛利与上杉成了家康盟友，三成便只得乖乖听命。对这些，家康心知肚明。但毛利辉元自从去年返回领国之后，就对家康和三成置之不顾，而是与会津的上杉景胜频频联系，或询问奥羽情形，或向上杉通报朝廷动态……

paragraphs.source_en: The late Taikō had laid the foundations, but if peace could not be maintained, everyone would concern himself only with preserving the status quo or perpetuating his own house. With minds so narrow, how could they unite to create an age of peace lasting for all generations?

units.source_en: The late Taikō had laid the foundations, but if peace could not be maintained, everyone would concern himself only with preserving the status quo or perpetuating his own house. With minds so narrow, how could they unite to create an age of peace lasting for all generations?
units.source_zh: 已故太阁虽已铺好基石，但只要无法维持太平局面，众人就只会盯住维持现状或是承继家业，如此心胸狭隘，怎能齐心协力，开创千秋万代的太平盛世？

paragraphs.source_zh: 已故太阁虽已铺好基石，但只要无法维持太平局面，众人就只会盯住维持现状或是承继家业，如此心胸狭隘，怎能齐心协力，开创千秋万代的太平盛世？

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's continual correspondence with Kagekatsu was, in fact, a test. In that sense, Maeda Toshinaga, who had yielded to Ieyasu at the urging of his mother Hōshun-in, had at least passed Ieyasu's test.

units.source_en: Ieyasu's continual correspondence with Kagekatsu was, in fact, a test.
units.source_zh: 家康不断与景胜保持联络，实际上是在试探。

units.source_en: In that sense, Maeda Toshinaga, who had yielded to Ieyasu at the urging of his mother Hōshun-in, had at least passed Ieyasu's test.
units.source_zh: 从这层意义上说，在母亲芳春院的劝说下向家康示弱的前田利长，好歹通过了家康的试探。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康不断与景胜保持联络，实际上是在试探。从这层意义上说，在母亲芳春院的劝说下向家康示弱的前田利长，好歹通过了家康的试探。

paragraphs.source_en: Through their frequent contacts, Ieyasu at last found the perfect opportunity to test Kagekatsu.

units.source_en: Through their frequent contacts, Ieyasu at last found the perfect opportunity to test Kagekatsu.
units.source_zh: 在频频接触中，家康终于迎来了考验景胜的良机。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在频频接触中，家康终于迎来了考验景胜的良机。

paragraphs.source_en: In the first month of Keichō 5, Tozawa Shirō Masamori, lord of Kakunodate Castle in Dewa and son-in-law of Torii Mototada, sent a man to report to Ieyasu: “Uesugi, the Middle Counselor, and his chief retainer Naoe Yamashiro-no-kami Kanetsugu are not only secretly plotting extensive repairs to numerous castles throughout their domain; claiming that Aizu, the seat of the Ashina clan for generations, lies in a hollow and is easy to attack and difficult to defend, they are also building a new castle at Kōzashihara, sixty-four ri from the castle.”

units.source_en: In the first month of Keichō 5, Tozawa Shirō Masamori, lord of Kakunodate Castle in Dewa and son-in-law of Torii Mototada, sent a man to report to Ieyasu: “Uesugi, the Middle Counselor, and his chief retainer Naoe Yamashiro-no-kami Kanetsugu are not only secretly plotting extensive repairs to numerous castles throughout their domain; claiming that Aizu, the seat of the Ashina clan for generations, lies in a hollow and is easy to attack and difficult to defend, they are also building a new castle at Kōzashihara, sixty-four ri from the castle.”
units.source_zh: 庆长五年正月，鸟居元忠之婿——出羽角馆城主户泽四郎政盛派人来向家康报告：“上杉中纳言与家老直江山城守兼续，不仅密谋大修领内众多城池，还以芦名氏数代以来的居城会津地处洼地、易攻难守为名，在离城六十四里的神刺原修筑新城。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长五年正月，鸟居元忠之婿——出羽角馆城主户泽四郎政盛派人来向家康报告：“上杉中纳言与家老直江山城守兼续，不仅密谋大修领内众多城池，还以芦名氏数代以来的居城会津地处洼地、易攻难守为名，在离城六十四里的神刺原修筑新城。”

paragraphs.source_en: At almost the same time, Hori Saemon-no-kami Hideharu, transferred to the Uesugi's former domain of Echigo, also reported that Kagekatsu harbored rebellious intentions. Before being transferred to Aizu, it appeared, Kagekatsu had collected six months' taxes from Echigo in advance, leaving Hori Hideharu in straitened circumstances. Filled with resentment, Hori Hideharu secretly informed Ieyasu that Kagekatsu seemed to have spent all the taxes collected on building the new castle, improving Echigo's highways, and repairing river channels and wharves.

units.source_en: At almost the same time, Hori Saemon-no-kami Hideharu, transferred to the Uesugi's former domain of Echigo, also reported that Kagekatsu harbored rebellious intentions.
units.source_zh: 几乎在同时，转封到上杉旧领越后的堀左卫门督秀治也来报告，说景胜有反心。

units.source_en: Before being transferred to Aizu, it appeared, Kagekatsu had collected six months' taxes from Echigo in advance, leaving Hori Hideharu in straitened circumstances.
units.source_zh: 原来，转封会津前，景胜在越后提前征了半年赋税，结果让堀秀治陷入困顿。

units.source_en: Filled with resentment, Hori Hideharu secretly informed Ieyasu that Kagekatsu seemed to have spent all the taxes collected on building the new castle, improving Echigo's highways, and repairing river channels and wharves.
units.source_zh: 怨气满怀的堀秀治向家康密告：景胜似把征缴的税金全用于筑新城、整治越后官道与修复河道码头等项。

paragraphs.source_zh: 几乎在同时，转封到上杉旧领越后的堀左卫门督秀治也来报告，说景胜有反心。原来，转封会津前，景胜在越后提前征了半年赋税，结果让堀秀治陷入困顿。怨气满怀的堀秀治向家康密告：景胜似把征缴的税金全用于筑新城、整治越后官道与修复河道码头等项。

paragraphs.source_en: On hearing the secret reports from Tozawa Masamori and Hori Hideharu, Ieyasu was neither surprised nor angered. As everyone knew, putting military preparations in order was a warrior's first duty upon assuming a new post; and Kagekatsu had been compelled to collect the annual levy early because the Gamō clan, transferred from Aizu to Utsunomiya, had themselves collected the taxes in advance. It was not such trifling matters that worried Ieyasu.

units.source_en: On hearing the secret reports from Tozawa Masamori and Hori Hideharu, Ieyasu was neither surprised nor angered.

units.source_en: As everyone knew, putting military preparations in order was a warrior's first duty upon assuming a new post; and Kagekatsu had been compelled to collect the annual levy early because the Gamō clan, transferred from Aizu to Utsunomiya, had themselves collected the taxes in advance.
units.source_zh: 众所周知，整顿军备乃是武将上任之后第一要务，而提前收取年赋，也是因从会津被转封到宇都宫的蒲生氏提前征收了赋税，景胜乃是不得已而为之。

units.source_en: It was not such trifling matters that worried Ieyasu.

units.source_zh: 家康担心的，并非这些琐碎小事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到户泽政盛和堀秀治密报，家康既不惊讶，也不恼怒。众所周知，整顿军备乃是武将上任之后第一要务，而提前收取年赋，也是因从会津被转封到宇都宫的蒲生氏提前征收了赋税，景胜乃是不得已而为之。家康担心的，并非这些琐碎小事。

paragraphs.source_en: At the beginning of the third month of Keichō 5, the northern snows were melting and the cherry blossoms were swelling in bud.

units.source_en: At the beginning of the third month of Keichō 5, the northern snows were melting and the cherry blossoms were swelling in bud.
units.source_zh: 庆长五年三月初，北国积雪融化、樱花含苞待放。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长五年三月初，北国积雪融化、樱花含苞待放。

paragraphs.source_en: “Will Uesugi Kagekatsu, lord of so vast a domain as 1.2 million koku, truly join hearts with me to build an age of peace? Does he truly possess such foresight and wisdom?” Ieyasu often asked himself. A narrow-minded man intoxicated by the display of high rank, rich stipends, and military might would become a source of unrest.

paragraphs.source_en: Having completed his test of Maeda Toshinaga in Keichō 4, Ieyasu now began to test Uesugi Kagekatsu.

units.source_en: Having completed his test of Maeda Toshinaga in Keichō 4, Ieyasu now began to test Uesugi Kagekatsu.
units.source_zh: 在庆长四年完成了对前田利长的考验之后，家康开始试探上杉景胜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在庆长四年完成了对前田利长的考验之后，家康开始试探上杉景胜。

paragraphs.source_en: The seasoned and calculating Ōtani Yoshitsugu prided himself on seeing much farther than Mashita Nagamori and Natsuka Masaie. He said, “Even so, the Middle Counselor cannot have sunk so low as to forget the Taikō's great favor and betray the young lord. As for whether the rumors abroad are true or false, in my opinion it would be best to dispatch envoys to investigate.”
